rules: One DOM input owner per document.
Working Campus statically loads the inert Settings presentation controller; opening Settings performs no model or inference runtime work.
Legacy realm pages may use the gateway compatibility loader until their static shell is rebased, but may not create a second Settings owner.
Realm pages may style the shared control but may not create a second Settings implementation or listener.
The Civweave campus may mark Settings controls but may not preload local-model bootstrap or attach direct Settings listeners.
Browser prototypes, DOM prototypes, and Settings API methods may not be monkey-patched to repair Settings behavior.
Credential helpers may expose explicit compatibility methods but may not intercept Settings input, patch Settings open(), or mutate credential state at module load.
Generative model work begins only from explicit inference submission.

family-navigation.capability: Five-system navigation and realm status chrome

guide-chat.capability: Five guide windows and canonical conversation workspace

local-ai-inference.rule: Settings may manage downloaded models but must never start inference on open.

host-node-access.capability: Device-bound Hub Node login, capacity sessions, and neuron quota telemetry
rules: Only the owner writes browser Hub capacity sessions and device login credentials.
Capacity bearer tokens remain tab-scoped in sessionStorage; device login credentials remain local and are never dispatched in events.
Cloudflare AI generation and validation require a verified Hub capacity session.
Paid-expansion availability may be discovered, but a new paid-expansion resident is never admitted without active membership authority.

node-reconstruction-backup.capability: Encrypted whole-node reconstruction checkpoints, retention, and replica storage
rules: Source systems remain canonical owners and export only explicitly portable records.
ABBA is an exact reconstruction/addressing codec and never replaces cryptographic commitments or authenticated encryption.
API keys, session bearer tokens, browser-bound signing keys, private authority keys, recovery secrets, and refresh tokens are never portable backup payloads.
Restore verifies the complete checkpoint before returning records and never silently mutates a source system.
Federated replica transport must retain application-level signatures and CMLP key separation.

private-messaging.capability: Offline-first encrypted member private messaging with opportunistic mesh and hidden online relay transport
rules: The user-facing member identity is @username; the derived username_pm@civweave.cc address is transport-only and must never be presented as the member's email address.
Private message plaintext is encrypted on the sending device before mesh, Hub, Worker, R2, or hidden-mail relay transport sees it.
The same encrypted envelope and UUID travel over local mesh and online relay so duplicate paths converge locally.
Inbound internet SMTP to _pm transport identities is rejected before message storage.
Paid human-visible email uses a separate entitlement-gated account and claim path.
Realm pages may call or present the canonical PM API but may not create realm-local messaging stores, encryption owners, relay protocols, or username registries.

radio.capability: Shared radio station and track suggestions

review.capability: Shared review surface and review handoffs
